#edu407Sum19 #smallpoems #clmooc on metaphors: https://twitter.com/jgmac1106/status/540582996731232256 followed by https://twitter.com/jgmac1106/status/540583750699335681
Let our classrooms unfold as museums
exhibits exploring futures
an archive of learning
masterfully
framed in
carefully
carved feedback
as teachers and students
curate a better tomorrow
